sampling_rule: X1,X2are independent Bernoulli(p). Observe X1first. If X1=1,stop immediately with record1and N=1. If X1=0,observe X2then stop with record00or01and N=2. The reported stopped sample mean is(sum observed successes)/N. The only possible stopped records are the three supplied strings;unobserved X2is not imputed when stopping after1.
estimator_class: Consider any deterministic estimator g(record)that assigns one finite real value to each of the three possible stopped records. Require E_p[g]=pfor EVERYp in[0,1],not only at the numeric comparison p. No extra randomization or observations are allowed.
target: Report expected N,mean and bias of the stopped sample mean,and its mean squared error as an estimator of p,at the supplied p. Determine whether this three-value class contains a unique estimator unbiased for every p;if so report its three record values in source order,otherwise null. Report that estimator variance at the numeric p. These calculations integrate over all possible stopped records,not a fixed-Nbinomial law.
